title: Kinyarwanda moderation lexicon
description: Schema for the JSON files this library loads. Two shapes are accepted: the structured form used by priv/data/rw_lexicon.json (categories with severities and actions), and a flat array of terms such as priv/data/rw_hate_speech.json. Contributors add words here; the library loads and compiles them at runtime.

flat.description: A flat list of single-token entries. The library loads it as one 'flat_terms' category with severity 'medium' and action 'flag', and reports version '0.0.0'. Use the structured form when you need per-category severities, actions or multi-word phrases.

version.description: Lexicon version. Bump when words are added or removed.

locale.description: BCP-47 style locale tag for the language this lexicon covers.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date of the last edit.

normalization.description: Per-lexicon overrides for the default normalization pipeline.

fold_l_r.description: Treat 'l' and 'r' as the same letter, a very common Kinyarwanda spelling variation.

strip_diacritics.description: Fold accented characters onto their base form.

collapse_repeats.description: Collapse runs of three or more identical letters down to one.

strip_prefixes.description: Match noun-class prefixes (umu-, aba-, iki-, ...) so inflected forms still hit. Increases false positives.

categories.description: Groupings of terms that share a severity and a suggested action.

action.description: Suggested handling: allow, flag for later, queue for review, or block.

description.description: Why these terms are grouped together.

phrases.description: Multi-word entries, matched as consecutive tokens.
